name: EXM_ITINERARY_RESERVATIONS
description: This table contains information about travel itinerary bookings or reservations made, which includes reservations for air travel, hotel, car rental and/or rail transportation.

columns.name: ITINERARY_RESERVATION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of a reservation in a travel itinerary.

columns.name: HOTEL_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System code of hotel location.

columns.name: PICKUP_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System code of pickup location for vehicle rental.

columns.name: RETURN_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Global Distribution System code of return location for vehicle rental.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ITINERARY_ID
columns.description: Itinerary to which reservation belongs.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFIRMATION_NUM
columns.description: Confirmation number for HOTEL and VEHICLE RENTAL reservations. Null for AIR and RAIL reservations because confirmation numbe is stored at the travel segment level in EXM_RESERVATION_ITEMS table.

columns.name: RESERVATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of reservation such as AIR,  HOTEL, RAIL or VEHICLE RENTAL.

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Version number of imported reservation record.  This number is incremented every time that data in reservation has been updated in the travel partner system from which data was imported.

columns.name: VALIDATION_FAILURE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether reservation has validation failures.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of reservation amount.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Reservation amount, which does not include tax.

columns.name: TOTAL_TAX
columns.description: Tax on reservation amount.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total reservation amount, which includes tax.

columns.name: LOWER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lowest amount available in the booking tool that was not chosen by employee.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Functional currency of primary ledger for business unit.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Reservation amount, which does not include tax, converted to functional currency of primary ledger for Business Unit.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_LOWER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Lowest amount available in the booking tool that was not chosen by employee. This amount is  converted to functional currency of primary ledger for business unit.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total reservation amount, which includes tax, that is converted to functional currency of primary ledger for business unit.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Conversion type used to convert amounts from transactional currency into functional currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used to convert amounts from transactional curency for functional currency.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Merchant identifier.  This column is populated only if a match is found for merchant_code against EXM_MERCHANTS table as part of  itinerary validation process.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CODE
columns.description: Merchant code for Hotel Chain or Car Rental Agency.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Merchant name for hotel or car rental agency.

columns.name: HOTEL_CODE
columns.description: Hotel code for a hotel reservation.

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Check-in date and time for hotel reservation and pickup time for vehicle rental.

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Checkout date and time for hotel reservation and drop-off time for vehicle rental.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ROOMS
columns.description: Number of hotel rooms for this hotel reservation.

columns.name: ROOM_CODE
columns.description: Hotel room type for this hotel reservation.

columns.name: BASE_RATE
columns.description: Daily base rate for this hotel reservation.

columns.name: RATE_DETAILS
columns.description: Details provided by the hotel for this hotel reservation.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_GUESTS
columns.description: Number of guests for this hotel reservation.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_1
columns.description: First line of address information for hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_2
columns.description: Second line of address information hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_3
columns.description: Third line of address information hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_4
columns.description: Fourth line of address information hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER_1
columns.description: First contact number hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER_2
columns.description: Second contact number hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER_3
columns.description: Third contact number hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: CONTACT_NUMBER_4
columns.description: Fourth contact number hotel or vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: HOTEL_CITY
columns.description: City in which hotel is located for which reservation is made.

columns.name: HOTEL_STATE
columns.description: State or province in which hotel is located for which reservation is made.

columns.name: HOTEL_STATE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the state or province in which hotel is located for which reservation is made.

columns.name: HOTEL_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country in which hotel is located for which reservation is made.

columns.name: HOTEL_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country in which hotel is located for which reservation is made.

columns.name: HOTEL_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical hotel location in Oracle Trading Community Architecture(TCA).  This column will only be populated if a geographical match is found in TCA using hotel city, state or province and country as part of the travel itinerary validation process.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description: Vehicle type for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_CITY
columns.description: Pickup city for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_STATE
columns.description: Pickup state or province for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_STATE_CODE
columns.description: Code of pickup state or province for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_COUNTRY
columns.description: Pickup country for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Pickup country code for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: PICKUP_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical rental vehicle pickup location in Oracle Trading Community Architecture(TCA). This column will only be populated if a geographical match is found in TCA using rental vehicle pickup city, state or province, and country as part of the travel itinerary validation process.

columns.name: RETURN_CITY
columns.description: Return city for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: RETURN_STATE
columns.description: Return state or province for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: RETURN_STATE_CODE
columns.description: Return state or province code for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: RETURN_COUNTRY
columns.description: Return country for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: RETURN_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Return country code for vehicle rental reservation.

columns.name: RETURN_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical rental vehicle return location in Oracle Trading Community Architecture(TCA). This column will only be populated if a geographical match is found in TCA using rental vehicle return city, state or province, and country as part of the travel itinerary validation process.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION
columns.description: Policy violation text displayed to employee while booking this reservation.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION_CODE
columns.description: Policy violation lookup_code that maps to policy violation text.  This column is populated only if match is found against lookup_code in FND_LOOKUPS table during the itinerary validation process.

columns.name: POLICY_JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Policy violation justification text provided by employee while booking this reservation.

columns.name: POLICY_JUSTIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Policy violation lookup_code that maps to policy violation justification text.  This column will only be populated if match was found against FND_LOOKUPS table during the itinerary validation process.
